description: Cancel a Nomads.com meetup the member organized. The cancel is posted in the community chat and everyone who RSVP'd gets a notification. It cannot be undone. Call without meetup_id to get the member's upcoming meetups with their ids. Authenticated as the member, like create_meetup. Ask the member to confirm first.

key.description: From https://nomads.com/settings. Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

meetup_id.description: From create_meetup, list_meetups, or this tool called without it

username.description: Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

name: cancel_meetup
